<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Patrick+Hand&display=swap');
.login-background {
  color-scheme: light;
  --background: 48 60% 97%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 15%;
  --card: 0 0% 100%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 15%;
  --popover: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 15%;
  --muted: 48 40% 93%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 30%;
  --accent: 48 40% 93%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 15%;
  --border: 0 0% 17%;
  --input: 0 0% 17%;
  --ring: 0 0% 17%;
  font-family: 'Patrick Hand', 'Comic Sans MS', 'Segoe Print', cursive;
  font-size: 18px;
  background-color: #fdfbf3;
  background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 79px, #f3b6b6 79px, #f3b6b6 81px, transparent 81px), linear-gradient(#d9e6f2 1.5px, transparent 1.5px);
  background-size: 100% 100%, 100% 32px;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 440px;
}

.login-panel {
  border: 2.5px solid #2b2b2b;
  border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px;
  background: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 6px 8px 0 rgba(43, 43, 43, 0.12);
  transform: rotate(-0.6deg);
}
.login-topbar button {
  color: #2b2b2b;
}
.login-form {
  font-size: 18px;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  height: auto;
  padding: 0;
  border: none;
  background: transparent;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tablist'] {
  gap: 10px;
  overflow: visible;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  flex: none !important;
  padding: 2px 12px;
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px;
  background: transparent !important;
  color: #555555;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 17px;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  border-color: #2b2b2b;
  background: {{accentColor}} !important;
  color: #2b2b2b;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #2b2b2b;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 400;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 46px;
  border: 2px solid #2b2b2b;
  border-radius: 255px 15px 225px 15px / 15px 225px 15px 255px;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #2b2b2b;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 18px;
  box-shadow: 2px 3px 0 rgba(43, 43, 43, 0.15);
}
.login-form .login-password input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  border-radius: 15px 225px 15px 255px / 255px 15px 225px 15px;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  outline: none;
  box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  border: 2px solid #2b2b2b;
  border-radius: 6px 3px 7px 3px / 3px 7px 3px 6px;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: #2b2b2b;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #2b2b2b;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #2b2b2b;
  font-size: 18px;
  font-weight: 400;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-style: wavy;
  text-decoration-color: #e8590c;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 50px;
  border: 2.5px solid #2b2b2b;
  border-radius: 15px 225px 15px 255px / 255px 15px 225px 15px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #2b2b2b;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 21px;
  font-weight: 400;
  box-shadow: 3px 4px 0 #2b2b2b;
  transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 1px 2px 0 #2b2b2b;
  transform: translate(2px, 2px) rotate(-0.4deg);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: #2b2b2b;
  font-size: 18px;
}
#footer {
  color: #555555;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
